environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9) behind API Gateway HTTP API with no request validation. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS. The DB_USER 'lambda_user' connects with a role that has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'public' schema. No WAF or input filtering at the API Gateway level. VPC-attached Lambda with direct RDS connectivity.

config.db_role_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO lambda_user
config.vpc: Lambda in same VPC as RDS, security group allows 5432
